newsitem.title: GERMANY: Dresdner's Sarrazin - share price too low.
newsitem.headline: Dresdner's Sarrazin - share price too low.

text.p: Dresdner Bank's chief executive Jergen Sarrazin said on Thursday that he believed the Dresdner's share price did not reflect the true value of the bank.
"The current price is not a reasonable valuation of our bank. There is a considerable gap," Sarrazin told the bank's annual news conference.
Sarrazin noted that the bank had 12 billion marks in hidden reserves on its equity holdings alone, which was not reflected in the share price.
Dresdner shares were trading at 58.05 marks, down 65 pfennigs, in bourse trade on Thursday.
